levels.surface: عبد الله بن محمد بن الحجال

notes: the report is a narrated encounter: Ali b. Ubaydullah says they were at the grave and Musa b. Ja'far came with his son and spoke; whether the Imam is a source or only in the scene is the ruling, so he is not written as a link
«نص آخر» is a heading, left out; «حدثنا أبي» gives the father as a bare relation
